tei:div.tei:p: 165)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: tshe sgrub yang bcud snying po bzhugs so: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye:

rnal 'byor ltar spyod ldan pa yis: tshe sgrub yang bcu snying po bzhugs so: spros med rgyun khyir zab mo bstan: yal bar ma dor sa ma ya: mkha' 'gro'i bskyed bzlas 'jug pa'i mthar: rdo rje tshe yi sgrub pa ni: āḥ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i spyi bo ru: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng: rigs bdag mgon po tshe dpag med: dmar gsal longs spyod rgyan chas rdzogs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag steng: 'chi med tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: phyogs bzhir tshe bdag rigs lnga dang: tshe yi lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi: gzhan yang tshe dbang rig 'dzin tshogs: ma 'dres rang byung chen por bskyed: ye shes 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong: sgyu ma chu zla ji bzhin bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba rnams: spyan drangs bskyed pa'i lha la thim: dam ye dbyer med ro gcig gyur: 166)thugs kar pad+ma rā ga yi: bum klong thugs srog hrīḥyig las: 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus: byin rlabs ye shes bdud rtsi yis: bum pa mer gyis gang bar bsam: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ āḥgu ru ā yu sid+dhi hrīḥ a ma ra ṇi dzi wan+ti ye swā hāḥ zhes grangs 'khyol mthar: rigs bdag tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa dang gnas lnga las 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi a nṛ hūm̐ gsum gyi rnam par rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs: gnas lnga'i 'khor lo lngar thim pas 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe la dbang cing skye 'chi bgres rgud thams cad dang bral ba mi 'gyur rdo rje'i srog thob par bsam: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ gu ru ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ g.yu bh+rūm̐ g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐ ā yur+dzñā na g.yu tshe nṛ dzaḥbh+rūm̐ swā hāḥ ci 'grub mthar: yang tshe bdag rigs lnga tshe lha mgyogs ma rnams kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis bdag gi bla tshe yar ba dngaḥ

chad pa dang: gas pa dang: nyams pa dang: lha 'dres brkus shing 'khyams pa dang: gdon dang bgegs kyis 'phrogs pa thams cad a nṛ hūm̐ gsum gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang gi thugs ka'i srog yig las thim pas bla tshe chad nyams yar ba thams cad sor 167)chud par bsam: rtsa sngags ci 'grub mthar: tshe 'gugs ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ spyi gtsug mi 'gyur bde chen pho brang nas: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: tshe bdag rigs lnga tshe lha mgyogs ma bzhi: tshe la dbang ba'i drang srong rig 'dzin tshogs: thugs rgyud bskul lo dbyings nas dgongs mdzod la: bdag gi bla tshe nyams dang 'khyams pa gsos: sha khams nyams na sa yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi sha khams nyams pa gsos: khrag khams nyams na chu yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi khrag khams nyams pa gsos: drod khams nyams pa me yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi drod khams nyams pa gsos: dbugs khams nyams pa rlung gi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi dbugs khams nyams pa gsos: sems khams nyams pa nam mkha'i bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi sems khams nyams pa gsos: phung khams skye mched dag pa lha yi ngang: ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin tshe rgyas thob: mi shigs mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tshe thob shog: bh+rūm̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod: gzhan yang tshe 'gugs dang bkra shis sogs kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o: sa ma ya: 'di la rtag tu brtson gyur na: 168) che 'phrang nges par sel bar 'gyur: the tshom med do rdo rje'i tshig: rtags mtshan lag tu longs dang gsal: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di'ang mkhyen yangs blo gros spyan can dge btsun dam pa bde 'byung gis bkra shis lha reg bcas nan cher bskul ngor mdo med 'chol mo bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes yar tshes dge bar ser dgon dben khrod nas bris pa'o// dge'o//
